idea.title: The Idea
idea.content:
"99 cents" is a social project of collective charity.

We believe that small actions by many people can change the world.

"99 cents" is a global platform where anyone from anywhere in the world can voluntarily send $0.99, making a simple and conscious act of kindness.

The project promises no rewards or benefits. It's not a purchase, not an investment, not a service — it's a choice.

We call it an experiment because we want to show how the power of one small action, repeated thousands of times, can bring real help to people.

howItWorks.title: How the Project Works
items: You voluntarily send 99 cents.
Your payment appears on the project's global map.
After payment, you earn the right to vote for projects that need help.
Voting takes place regularly.
The project with the most votes receives all collected funds.

voting.title: Voting
items: Only users who have made a transfer can vote.
One user can vote once per day.
From all submitted applications, the system randomly selects several projects for voting.
One project wins and receives the entire collected amount.

whatYouGet.title: What You Get
whatYouGet.content: You receive nothing material. No bonuses, gifts, or privileges.
items: The awareness of having done a good deed
Your dot on the world map
Participation in a global process of helping others
whatYouGet.quote: 99 cents is enough not to be a zero.

transparency.title: Transparency
items: All transactions are public.
All transfers to winning projects are documented.
The project does not charge any commission on donations.
Fees may be charged by banks and payment systems.
Information about fund distribution is available to all project participants.

legality.title: Project Legality
legality.content: The project does not fund initiatives or actions that violate the laws or regulations of any country.

prohibited.title: Prohibited Content
prohibited.content: The project does not support materials containing propaganda of violence, discrimination, extremism, copyright infringement, or other illegal activities.

aml.title: International Compliance
aml.content: The project complies with international standards for combating money laundering (AML) and terrorist financing (CFT).

responsibility.title: Responsibility
responsibility.content:
Participation in the project is completely voluntary.

By sending 99 cents, you confirm that you have read and accept the project rules.

cta.note: This is a separate voluntary donation to support the "99 cents" project.

full.title: Full Transparency
full.content: We believe trust is built on openness. Every cent you send is tracked and accounted for publicly.

publish.title: What We Publish
items: Total amount collected in real-time
Number of participants and their geographic distribution
Results of each voting round
Reports on fund transfers to winners
All blockchain transactions (for crypto payments)

blockchain.title: Blockchain Verification
blockchain.content: All USDC payments are recorded on the blockchain and can be verified by anyone.

reports.title: Monthly Reports
reports.content: Every month we publish a detailed report:
items: How much was collected
Which project won the vote
Proof of fund transfer
Feedback from recipients

fees.title: Zero Hidden Fees
fees.content: The project takes no commission from your 99 cents. The only costs are bank fees, payment system fees, or blockchain gas.

availability.title: Information Availability
items: All information is available on the website without registration
Any participant can see the current balance, number of participants, and countries
Reports on each project are published immediately after the fund transfer

cta.note: By clicking, you proceed to send 99 cents and participate in a global experiment of good deeds.

steps.title: Fundraising
steps.content: Participants send 99 cents each. Funds accumulate during the voting period.

steps.title: Voting
steps.content: Participants vote for projects they want to support. One person — one vote per day.

steps.title: Winner Selection
steps.content: At the end of the period, the project with the most votes wins.

steps.title: Fund Transfer
steps.content: The entire collected amount goes to the winning project.
